notes: Input FIRST so k single-field requests on one input share the long prefix.

Terminator owns the trailing space: space-prefixed digits are not single tokens (spike 0.3), so a prefix ending 'answer:' would make the grammar force a bare digit against the model's preference and corrupt position 0.

Render ONLY via jev.spec.render_prompt. Ollama exposes no cache-hit flag, but byte-identical text is what makes any prefix reuse possible; measured prompt-eval drops ~40% on the follow-up tasks of one input.
